description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

We’re a small, senior Business Development team that grows Life360 through partnerships with leading companies. Our focus is named partners: we build the target list, open doors, close the deals, and stay involved after launch so that each partnership performs. We measure ourselves on members who become paying subscribers, not just sign-ups … every deal has to make sense for the business. We also help decide what Life360 should build, partner on, or buy. And because no team has every relationship, we’re good at bringing in outside experts who do. If you like opening doors and seeing your deals move the company’s results while helping keep families safe, this is the team for you.

About the Job

Life360 is the family safety and connection platform trusted by more than 100 million monthly active users worldwide. The next stage of our global growth will come from partnerships with the largest consumer technology and AI companies, partners who can bring Life360 to millions of families. We're hiring a senior business development practitioner to forge strategic partnerships and turn them into results.

You'll decide which partners matter most and why, get in front of the people who can say yes, and lead each deal from first conversation through launch and growth. You'll join a deliberately focused team where each person owns a small set of high-value partners and goes deep. 

The US-based salary range for this position is $190,000 to $296,500. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

In Your First Year

  • Set the direction for your partners. In your first 90 days, you’ll build a clear point of view on your partner targets: large consumer and technology companies, typically with millions of customers, in the US and in Life360’s priority international markets. Examples include device and wearable makers, financial services, and consumer apps and platforms. For each target, you’ll work out what the value is for them and for Life360, who to connect with, and which deals are worth pursuing. You’ll own that plan and keep it current.
  • Open new doors. You'll create opportunities that are yours from the start. You'll open connections with decision-makers at large partners, build relationships across their organizations, and turn initial conversations into real negotiations.
  • Sign three partners and launch two. By the end of your first year, you’ll have signed strategic distribution partnerships with three key partners, with at least two live and generating monetizable MAU or paying subscribers. Those partnerships will keep growing after year one, adding monetizable members and revenue that noticeably accelerate Life360 past its company goals.
  • Rally both sides. You'll bring together product, engineering, marketing, legal, and finance at Life360, along with your counterparts at each partner, to move every deal forward and keep it growing after signature.

What We’re Looking For

These are must-haves.

  • You open doors yourself. You get energy from reaching out to senior people at large companies you haven’t met yet, and you keep going when the first answer is no. You can point to partnerships that started with your outreach.
  • You have executive relationships at the companies that matter most to us. You have working, productive connections at major technology platforms such as Meta, Google, and OpenAI, and in industries such as travel, financial services, and consumer services. You can get a serious meeting with the right leaders and turn it into a deal.
  • You build the strategy and close the deal. You’ve decided which partners a company should pursue and why, and brought executives on both sides to a decision. You’ve led complex negotiations with large companies and driven those partnerships through launch to results that moved company-level member growth and revenue.
  • You bring people with you. You lead without authority. Product, engineering, legal, finance, and your counterparts at each partner want to work with you, because you build genuine, trusting relationships on both sides of a deal.
  • You work AI-native. You develop and apply AI-enabled workflows that improve how strategic partnerships are identified, evaluated, and executed, helping establish scalable practices across the team.

You’ll typically have around 15 years in technology business development or strategic partnerships, with substantial time at a senior level, ideally in mobile consumer apps, connected devices, or consumer subscription services.

How We'll Get to Know You

Our process is built around real work. You'll walk us through a partnership you originated, from the first outreach to the results it produced. You'll show us an AI workflow or agent you use in your deal work. You'll also join a working session where you choose a large potential partner for Life360 and show us how you'd open the door, which deal you'd pursue, and how you'd get it done.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference 

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. 
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. 
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. 

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!
